description: Canonical CTA registry per Directive §34. Single primary CTA, secondary, and contextual CTAs — no random alternation.

primary.label: START A CONVERSATION
primary.description: Primary conversion CTA — every high-intent button funnels here
primary.usage: Hero sections, final CTA bars, high-intent conversion points

secondary.label: REQUEST AN AI READINESS ASSESSMENT
secondary.description: What We Do above-the-fold assessment request
secondary.usage: What We Do page, service pages, solution detail pages

contextual.label: EXPLORE AI COMPANY BUILDER
contextual.description: AI Company Builder product tour entry point
contextual.usage: AI Company Builder page, homepage product section, solution cards

contextual.label: EXPLORE USE CASES
contextual.usage: Use Cases page, sector pages, homepage use case section

contextual.label: EXPLORE SOLUTIONS
contextual.usage: Solutions page, What We Do page, homepage solutions section

contextual.label: READ PHAROS INSIGHTS
contextual.usage: Insights page, homepage insights section, article CTAs

rules: Primary CTA (START A CONVERSATION) must be visually dominant on every high-intent conversion point
Secondary CTA (REQUEST AN AI READINESS ASSESSMENT) used for assessment-focused entry points
Contextual CTAs used only in their designated contexts — never as generic replacements
Retired phrasing must not return — enforce via lint/check
CTA labels are canonical — do not vary capitalization, wording, or punctuation
All CTAs route to /contact except contextual exploration CTAs which route to their respective sections
